games.title: Hello Hearth
games.tagline: The smallest game there is: it says hello and counts how often you started it.

sections.heading: Level one
sections.lead: The game carries a data file now, to try updates.
lines: Updating keeps the old version in Backups.

sections.heading: First light
sections.lead: The smallest game there is: it says hello and counts how often you started it.
lines: Shows what Hearth hands every game when it starts it.
Keeps its count in your saves folder, which Hearth backs up.

games.title: Kindle & Keep
games.tagline: Keep the hearthfire burning through the night.

sections.heading: Your character
sections.lead: Your keeper is the character you made on Hearth's Character page, and your friends see theirs.
lines: Your body, face, proportions, hair, brows, beard and colours, with your marks, freckles and stubble.
At the muster you see yourself in every kit; the body buttons make way for "Your character".
Change your character in Hearth while you play, and your keeper changes with it.
No character yet? You keep the kit's own keeper, and still choose the body at the muster.

sections.heading: What a kit covers
sections.lead: A kit's gear goes over your character, and covers what it covers.
lines: The Ranger's hood: a buzzcut underneath, whatever hair you picked.
The Warden's helm: your hair and beard tucked under its band.
Your saved character never changes: take the hood off by picking another kit.

sections.heading: The Warden
sections.lead: A third keeper: the shield. It fights up close and pulls the Gloam onto itself. Press 3 at the muster.
lines: Sword: a chain of three swings that hits everything in reach in front of you; the third throws them back.
Q Challenge: every walker within 12 m turns on you, and you take 40% less while it lasts.
E Shield Wall: claws from the front do nothing, and whatever struck it is thrown back and dazed.
Space Shield Rush: a charge that throws walkers aside.
Bulwark: tough, and the pieces near you take less damage.
Eight boons of its own, from Keen Edge to Gatekeeper's Oath.

sections.heading: Keepers heal
sections.lead: Health comes back slowly and steadily while you're up, by day and by night.
lines: The Ranger and the Tinker heal 1 health a second, the Warden 2.

sections.heading: The Tinker
sections.lead: A second keeper, and you choose yours at the muster before the first day.
lines: Crossbow: heavy bolts that pierce two enemies, spanned by hand between shots.
Q sets a Sentry, a clockwork bolt-thrower. E lays a Snap Trap. Space leaps on Springheels, even over walls.
Handy: the Tinker builds for less, works faster, and mends damaged pieces (hold F).
Eight boons of its own, from Heavy Bolts to Twin Sentries.
Everyone picks at once and sees each other's picks. Two keepers may take the same kit.

sections.heading: Expeditions
sections.lead: Reasons to leave the light by day.
lines: Old braziers to relight with embers: each grows the land, and the Gloam goes for it at night.
Chop trees and quarry stone outside the light, and carry the load home. Towers cost stone.
Drop a load and it stays as a pile you can pick up again.
A compass in the top right shows the island, the sites and where the Gloam comes from. T tracks a site.

sections.heading: Boons
sections.lead: At dawn the team votes on a keep boon, and each keeper picks one of their own.
lines: A tie is drawn at random, the same for everyone.
Tab opens the boon panel: every boon you hold, with its real numbers.

sections.heading: A new look
sections.lead: The island, the fire and the keepers, redone.
lines: The hearth burns like a real fire, and gutters when it's hurt.
Painted ground and props, a larger island with finer terrain, and a clear sea.
Past the firelight, the night is dark fog and smoke.
The keepers are new: Rangers and Tinkers, firelit, with an ink line, and you see them through walls.
The keeper runs while shooting, aims with the upper body, draws a real bow, and flinches when hit.
Flare has a cast, a flight and an impact. Moths fall when they die, and souls fly home to the fire.
A new HUD around the hearth's crown, with icons rendered from the game's own models.
Smoother edges (anti-aliasing; F2 changes it).

sections.heading: Playing together
sections.lead: Smoother co-op through a Hearth lobby.
lines: Join a game that's already playing: you watch until dawn, then your keeper joins.
Close the game and press Playing in the lobby to come back to your own keeper.

sections.heading: Fixes and quality
sections.lead: The game opens borderless fullscreen, with its icon and a loading screen.
lines: F11 or Alt+Enter switches to a window.
Shadows no longer flicker on moving characters, and enemies stand on the ground.
Hold the right mouse button to take a piece down, instead of a single click.
